title: Get approval for actions with a significant impact on nationally protected matters
what: Get approval from the Australian Government before taking an action likely to have a significant impact on a matter of national environmental significance.

laws.title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999

sources.title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999
sources.quote: A person must not take an action that: (a) has or will have a significant impact on the world heritage values of a declared World Heritage property;

triggers.note: Taking an action likely to have a significant impact on a matter of national environmental significance.

reach.condition: if it takes an action likely to have a significant impact on a matter of national environmental significance (e.g. clearing habitat of a listed threatened species)

sources.title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999
sources.quote: A person must not take an action that: (a) has or will have a significant impact on the world heritage values of a declared World Heritage property;

confidence_note: Quoted at s 12 (world heritage); Part 3 sets the same prohibition for each matter.

assessment.summary: Actions likely to have a significant impact on a matter of national environmental significance need approval, with assessment and conditions.

marks.reason: Assessment times and conditions add cost, risk and delay to projects that need approval.
Referral, assessment and compliance with approval conditions.
